rationale.conceptual: The task requires implementing a coupled steady-state heat conduction and thermoelectric (Seebeck/Peltier) finite-volume model with temperature-dependent material polynomials. This is an established method but demands a multi-part solver implementation and correct handling of thermoelectric coupling, beyond a simple library call.
rationale.execution: The pipeline has four main stages: mesh setup with given geometry, implementing nonlinear coupled equations, sweeping load current for two heating scenarios, and generating I-V/P curves. While external data is minimal, the solver integration and parametric sweeps constitute a moderate engineering orchestration.
